notes.title: Post Void is in Difficult Games Bash!
notes.notes:
Heeelloo, it’s us again, YCJY: christopher and josef! it’s been some time since we did anything Post Void-related as we’ve been busy working on Keep Driving the last few years. Nothing new in the game per say, but we’re is participating in this week’s Difficult Games Fest with a lot of other great games.

[h3]Post Void 20% off[/h3] 

The event is happening here on Steam from [i]October 28 to 31[/i]. It’s the celebration of difficulty and challenge, that hopefully leads to flow and ecstasy. For those of you who have already played Post Void, we imagine you’ll agree with the assessment…

If you haven’t played Post Void already: why not?[u] It's cheap and distills the fast paced fps genre to its core. [/u]speed is your friend, time is your enemy. It’s hypnotic, francis bacon inspired color palette, and even a monthly leader board where you might have a chance to reach the top 10. 

[i]Oh and Our new game [b]Keep Driving[/b] is also on this festival... it's not difficult unlesss you down a bottle of wine, have a bad relationship with your parents, and spend all your money on cigarettes while on your road trip. 
[/i]
For the latest of what we’re up to, be sure to follow us on [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord[/url]! See you around! :) 

p.s. we're so close to 10k reviews, so if you have played it please write a review!

notes.title: KEEP DRIVING DEMO
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi again everyone! Christopher and Josef here again. [/h3]

Firstly, a massive thank you to everyone for the feedback and such an amazingly positive reaction to Keep Driving. We have been completely blown away by your comments, especially on Twitter, where things [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames/status/1841466616992670034]absolutely blew up[/url]! Kotaku, Rock Paper Shotgun and PC Games even [url=https://kotaku.com/keep-driving-road-trip-sim-rpg-chill-steam-trailer-pc-1851671194?rev=1728679747622]gave us a shout out[/url] already!

[h3]You can watch the reveal trailer below if you missed it.[/h3]

Today, we're excited to let you get hands-on with our first-ever demo for the game. You’ll get a taste of things to come as you spend a weekend driving to your friend's house to play a video game, encountering hitchhikers, taking odd jobs, and keeping your vehicle running on the way. You’ll get a sneak peek into our procedurally generated world with its naturalistic pixel art, a couple of endings including a specially made main story for the demo, and an awesome but limited (for the demo) soundtrack by local indie bands Westkust and Crystal Boys!

We’d LOVE to hear what you think of the demo, so feel free let us know on [url=www.x.com/ycjygames]Twitter[/url], or join our [url=https://discord.gg/j3zjBjR]Discord[/url], which will become more active in the coming months. 

[previewyoutube=ag7Ss-Hxdw0;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!
Christopher & Josef

notes.title: Keep Driving Reveal
notes.notes:
Hey!
As some of you may know we are painfully business savvy. So with that in mind we decided to, instead of building on a game and aesthetic that sold really well; instead of making a post void 2 or something similar, we decided to make a game that's completely the opposite. A game that's slow, with muted colors, and no murdering things.

Anyway, It’s been in the works a long time (directly after post void) and we’re pretty excited to be able to reveal it now. Featuring: a procedurally generated world, a naturalistic pixel art, multiple endings, a soundtrack composed by local indie bands, and more. 

You’ll embark on a journey on the road, where you’ll pick up hitchhikers with their own personalities and stories. You’ll also customize and repair your car so that you can solve the challenges of the road using a pretty (we think, at least) unique turn-based ‘combat’ system. 

Hope you guys take a look at the new trailer even though it's so different from Post Void.

We’ll be sure to provide all updates to keep all of the game’s followers in the loop on the actual game page. Any questions or thoughts that you have about our reveal trailer – let us know! 

Be sure to follow us on [url=https://x.com/YCJYgames]Twitter [/url]and join our [url=https://discord.gg/QnPAhE57]Discord[/url], which will become more active in the coming months. Until next time! 

Cheers!
Christopher & Josef

notes.title: This breakneck FPS is Doom meets Hotline Miami after dropping acid
notes.notes: Post Void is a difficult game to explain. Which I fully appreciate isn't the most helpful start to a spotlight feature. On face value, it's loud, garish, ultra-violent, super-colorful, and uber-challenging. But there's also something about Post Void that doesn't immediately meet the eye. Something that can only be understood by playing, that maybe can't be fully grasped if you weren't around for the crude '90s first-person shooters that it's so heavily inspired by... Read more.

notes.title: POST VOID GAMEPAD UPDATE
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce the release of Post Void 1.4.
This version of POST VOID adds some features that were created to the recently released console release of POST VOID.

[h2]UPDATE:[/h2]
[strike][b]It seems this build was somehow crashing for a lot of players. We have temporarily reverted back to the older version, but will try to resolve this asap. For now, if you want to try the new version you can choose the public beta-branch to access it.[/b][/strike]

[b]Build is now live again and should not cause crashes anymore. Sorry for the inconvenience![/b]


[h2]NEW FEATURES:[/h2]

[h3]GAMEPAD SUPPORT[/h3]
POST VOID now supports gamepad controls. We're very happy how the gamepad controls ended up and worked closely with porting developer Zach Reedy who did an amazing job with them. All buttons are rebindable and the game works perfectly on the Steam Deck. (Verification on deck should soon be approved, but it works very well already)

[h3]LOCALIZATION[/h3]
New languages are now available in the options menu, the following languages are available:
- English
- French
- Spanish
- German
- Dutch
- Korean
- Japanese
- Traditional Chinese
- Simplified Chinese
- Arabic
- Russian

Thanks to Super Rare games for letting us use the localization for the console version for STEAM.
Extra thanks to Isla Pleasure Partridge for the Russian translation and Malek Al-R. and Montassar Ghanmi for the Arabic localization.

[h3]MONTHLY LEADERBOARDS[/h3]
As an extra little feature we decided to add Monthly leaderboards to POST VOID. These will be reset at the start of every month. Looking forward to compete with everyone for the top spots every month!

[h3]IMPORTANT NOTES[/h3]
This new version should run better overall as it's been optimized very well. You might, however, notice that the game will start with the tutorial again and you will need to re-apply any settings you've set in the old version, as the saves are handled differently.
Don't worry about your high-score though. As long as you've [b]submitted to the leaderboard once[/b], your game will load your high-score from the steam servers and set it locally. [b]There is [u]no way[/u] for your score to be overwritten on the main leaderboard.[/b]

Thanks for everyone who plays and enjoys POST VOID
Cheers,
Christopher & Josef

notes.title: POST VOID 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b]POST VOID[/b]

Hello,
Christopher here, programmer and 1/2 of YCJY.
First of all I want to thank everyone for all the great reviews given to POST VOID!

We finally have a new patch out for POST VOID. It has some smaller fixes that should up the performance and enjoyment of the game without removing anything.


[b]NEW PATCH[/b]

Here are the patch notes:

-fixed a bug which sometimes made enemies spawn on top of each other
-fixed a bug which would make the player get out of bounds (and sometimes crash the game)
-fixed so you can pause in the tutorial (so you can invert your y-axis at the start of the game etc)
-added some major improvements to how the memory is handled (should reduce lag)

-added an artbook with Josef's concept art and some early ideas we had for the game. You can find this in the game files (right click game in library -> manage -> browse game files)

-added a reworked grain shader made by our good friend Jonatan Söderström of Dennaton Games (Mostly known for Hotline Miami 1&2). Be sure to check it out!(by enabling grain in the video options)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37527017/e4190fc10cf5001cc478c944b3dfd7f32f3da120.png[/img]
(Preview of a page from the artbook)

[b]FUTURE[/b]

We've had quite a few requests of extra game-modes like endless modes or some kind of survival-mode etc. At first (when we just had released the game) we thought about maybe adding something like this, but the more we thought about it, the more we realized it would go against the main vision we had with POST VOID in the first place.

With POST VOID we wanted to make a focused, cheap and intense little game were we could focus on iterating and improving a simple game loop as much as we could.
Endless mode (which is probably the most requested feature) would require some major re-balancing and could easily end up being more of an endurance-test rather than a test of the player's skills. We believe the identity of the game could easily be lost by adding and forcing new modes and features onto it.

As of now, we've already started working on a new, much bigger, project, that we've planned for quite some time. It will be VERY different from POST VOID, or any game we've previously worked on.

Thanks again, everyone who as played and enjoyed POST VOID. We're really proud of what it became and that so many seems to enjoy it!

Cheers,

Christopher & Josef, YCJY Games



Oh and by the way, we have a merch store: https://merch.whycjwhy.com/
Most of the stuff is sold out but we will order more stuff soon! (More posters and T-shirts!)

notes.title: Post Void review
notes.notes:
Post Void review

  • Developer: YCJY Games
  • Publisher: YCJY Games
  • Release:
  • On: Windows
  • From: Steam
  • Price: £2.33/$3/€2.50

I have only reached the void while drunk. I had been too conscious before then. I didn’t yet understand.

Post Void, I had thought, was about being fast. I was probably too old to ever be good at it. That never mattered even when I thought it was true, but it isn’t. Post Void is about letting the game take you.

Its hypnotic rhythms, its lurid colours, its cacophony of violence and strangled, somehow endlessly escalating guitars. There is a space in your mind between reflex and conscious decision, between panic and triumph. That is where Post Void is set, I think. It’s certainly where it takes me.

If not for The Bundle, this game would have been the best deal of the year. You should play it.

Asked to explain, I can only go by the notes she left behind. They start out lucid enough, but, well.
